rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING DRAG RACING IN PUBLIC ROADS AND PRESCRIBING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \" Drag Racing Ban Act \"
rows.abstract: States that drag racing, that involves the employment of two or more private motor vehicles driven side by side within a specified distance at accelerating speeds with the objective to outdo each other, or the employment of motor vehicles not necessarily driven side by side over a common course, is hereby declared banned or prohibited; Also includes those public utility vehicles randomly overtaking each other for the purpose of getting passengers first or merely for the purpose of outdistancing each other, is likewise prohibited.

rows.author: H091;
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING AND MAINSTREAMING PAYMENT FOR ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICES (PES) IN POLICY AND INVESTMENT PROGRAMS
rows.title_short: Institutionalizing And Mainstreaming Payment For Environmental Services ( P E S) In Policy And Investment Programs
rows.abstract: Defines Several Terms Among Others As Follows:  Ancestral Domains, Biological Diversity Or Biodiversity, Carbon Sequestration, Climate Change, Commmunity-based Forest Management Strategy, Environment Externalities, Environment Services, Iccs/ips.  Adopts Several Policies As Follows:  Sustainable Use Of The Country´s Environment And Natural Resources; Common Rights But Differentiated Responsibilities And Accountabilities Of Environment And Natural Resource (enr) Suppliers/providers And Users/beneficiaries; Climate Change Mitigation And Adaptation. Provides For Several Objectives As Follows: Create Awareness And Appreciation Of Pes As A Strategy In Attaining Sustainable Development; Provide A Platform/entry Point/legal/institutional Framework For Use And Management Of Resources Aside From Energy And Mining Under A Pes Scheme; Develop Capacity Of Major Stakeholders Regarding Pes Implementation; Conduct Environmental And Natural Resources Accounting; Mainstream A Pes Mechanism In Policy And Investment Programs Of The Phil. Council For Sustainable Dev't And Other Relevant Institutions; Encourages Diff. Forms And Modes Of Pes Such As, But Not Limited To Rewarding Upland Peoples For Ecosystem Services (rupes), Carbon Trading, Reduction Of Emissions From Deforestation And Degradation (redd), Conditional Cash Transfer For Enviromental Protection And Management, Green Corporate Social Responsibility (csr, Ecological Fees And Polluter Fees
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2017-02-07
